passives.name: Academic Probation
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to all allies for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). Increases damage dealt by all attacks of all allies proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on the target. When attacking, if the target is inflicted with a debuff, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_4]. After attacking, if the target is not inflicted with a debuff, ignores Resilience and Immunity, and inflicts an irremovable Shocked for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000044_4_1] turn(s).
